15-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (105-bet) - INTERNET: FAQs.

Yuqorida o'ngda YaShIL yorliqda oq '15', chapida 'Surf the Net!'.

CHAP TOMON (to'q ko'k fon):
• Katta to'q sariq 'Reading'.
4) 'Read the information leaflet about the Internet, and match the questions (a-f) to the numbered spaces (1-6), as in the example. Then, explain the words in bold.'
   SARIQ VARAQA 'The Internet: FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions)':
   Kirish: 'The Internet is WITHOUT DOUBT one of the most important INVENTIONS in history. It was started in 1968 by the US government, but at first it was used MAINLY by scientists. Since 1990, when the World Wide Web was CREATED, it has changed the world, and its uses ARE GROWING every day.'
   1 (a) ... What exactly is the Internet? (namuna) 'The Internet is a network (several networks, in fact) of millions of computers around the world, CONNECTED by phone lines, satellite or cable, so that all the computers on the net can EXCHANGE information with each other.'
   2 ...... 'Not quite. The Internet links COMPUTERS, and the World Wide Web is a system which links the INFORMATION stored inside these computers.'
   3 ...... 'A company or organisation stores its information in electronic documents on one of the Internet computers, somewhere in the world. This computer SPACE - the company's web site - has an address, in the same way that every telephone has a number. To visit a web site, you simply ENTER THE ADDRESS. Your computer is connected to the web site, a document is downloaded, and a page appears on your computer screen.'
   4 ...... 'When you visit a web site looking for information, some words on the page may be UNDERLINED, showing that there is more information about the SUBJECT in another document. If you CLICK on one of these words, the Web AUTOMATICALLY connects your computer to a new document or web site, even if this is stored thousands of kilometres away. You're SURFING THE NET!'
   5 ...... 'The main use of the Internet is to find information - for your schoolwork or job, or just to find out more about your hobbies, sports or CURRENT EVENTS. You can also use the Internet to read newspapers and magazines, play games, plan your holiday or buy things from your favourite shop. E-mail makes it possible to send electronic messages anywhere in the world in seconds, and you can use the Internet to 'CHAT' with people and make new friends.'
   6 ...... 'If you don't already use the Internet, all you need to get started is a computer, a modem and a phone line. Using the Internet is getting cheaper and easier all the time. Are you ready to surf the net? There's a whole exciting Internet world out there waiting for you!'

O'NG USTUN:
   Savollar: a What exactly is the Internet? b What do I need in order to use the Internet? c How do I "surf the net"? d That's the same thing as the Web, isn't it? e What can I use the Internet for? f What is a web site, and how do I visit one?
• Katta to'q sariq 'Language Development'.
5) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Qiya: 'web, surf, exchange, computer, change, get, electronic, enter, current, phone, important'. 1 ...... inventions 2 to ...... the world 3 ...... lines 4 to ...... information 5 ...... documents 6 a ...... site 7 to ...... the address 8 a ...... screen 9 to ...... the net 10 ...... events 11 to ...... started.
6) 'Fill in the correct prepositions, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' 1 ...... doubt; 2 exchange information ...... each other; 3 ...... the world; 4 appear ...... the screen; 5 ...... the page; 6 information ...... sth; 7 to click ...... sth; 8 waiting ...... sb; 9 stored ...... a computer; 10 find out ...... sth.
• To'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the text again, then use the notes below to talk about the Internet.' KO'K JADVAL: Internet = network of computers around the world | You need: computer, modem and phone line | To surf the net, you: enter a web site address, connected to the web site, download document, page appears on screen, click on underlined words, connected to new documents/web sites | You can use it to: find information for schoolwork/job/hobbies/sports/current events, read newspapers/magazines, play games, plan holidays, buy things, send electronic messages (e-mail), 'chat' with people, make new friends.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '105'.

exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

Internet, shubhasiz, tarixdagi eng
muhim ixtirolardan biri. U 1968
yilda AQSh hukumati tomonidan
boshlangan, lekin dastlab asosan
olimlar tomonidan ishlatilgan. 1990
yildan, Butunjahon o'rgimchak to'ri
yaratilganidan beri, u dunyoni
o'zgartirdi va uning qo'llanilishi
har kuni o'sib bormoqda.

1) Internet aslida nima?
Internet - telefon liniyalari,
sun'iy yo'ldosh yoki kabel orqali
ulangan, dunyo bo'ylab millionlab
kompyuterlar tarmog'i (aslida bir
necha tarmoq), shunda tarmoqdagi
barcha kompyuterlar bir-biri bilan
ma'lumot almasha oladi.

2) Bu Veb bilan bir xil narsami?
Unchalik emas. Internet
KOMPYUTERLARNI bog'laydi, Butunjahon
o'rgimchak to'ri esa bu
kompyuterlarda saqlanadigan
MA'LUMOTNI bog'lovchi tizim.

3) Veb-sayt nima va unga qanday
kiraman?
Kompaniya yoki tashkilot
ma'lumotini dunyoning biror yeridagi
Internet kompyuterlaridan birida
elektron hujjatlarda saqlaydi. Bu
kompyuter maydoni - kompaniyaning
veb-sayti - har telefonda raqam
bo'lgani kabi manzilga ega. Saytga
kirish uchun shunchaki manzilni
kiritasiz. Kompyuteringiz saytga
ulanadi, hujjat yuklab olinadi va
ekraningizda sahifa paydo bo'ladi.

4) Internetda qanday 'kezaman'?
Ma'lumot izlab saytga kirganingizda,
sahifadagi ba'zi so'zlar tagiga
chizilgan bo'lishi mumkin - bu mavzu
haqida boshqa hujjatda ko'proq
ma'lumot borligini ko'rsatadi. Agar
shu so'zlardan biriga bossangiz, Veb
avtomatik ravishda kompyuteringizni
yangi hujjat yoki saytga ulaydi -
hatto u minglab kilometr uzoqda
saqlansa ham. Siz Internetda
kezyapsiz!

5) Internetdan nima uchun
foydalanishim mumkin?
Internetning asosiy vazifasi -
ma'lumot topish: maktab ishi yoki
ish uchun, yoki shunchaki sevimli
mashg'ulot, sport yoki joriy voqealar
haqida ko'proq bilish uchun.
Internetdan gazeta va jurnal o'qish,
o'yin o'ynash, ta'til rejalashtirish
yoki sevimli do'koningizdan narsa
sotib olish uchun ham foydalanishingiz
mumkin. E-mail dunyoning istalgan
yeriga soniyalarda elektron xabar
yuborishga imkon beradi, va
Internetdan odamlar bilan 'suhbat'
qurish va yangi do'stlar orttirish
uchun foydalanishingiz mumkin.

6) Internetdan foydalanish uchun nima
kerak?
Agar hali Internetdan
foydalanmasangiz, boshlash uchun
kerak bo'lgan narsa - kompyuter,
modem va telefon liniyasi.
Internetdan foydalanish tobora
arzonlashib va osonlashib bormoqda.
Internetda kezishga tayyormisiz? U
yerda sizni butun hayajonli Internet
dunyosi kutmoqda!


QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  without doubt = shubhasiz
  inventions = ixtirolar
  mainly = asosan
  created = yaratilgan
  are growing = o'sib bormoqda
  connected = ulangan
  exchange = almashmoq
  space = maydon, joy
  enter the address = manzilni
    kiritmoq
  underlined = tagiga chizilgan
  subject = mavzu
  click = bosmoq
  automatically = avtomatik
  surfing the net = Internetda
    kezish
  current events = joriy voqealar
  chat = suhbatlashmoq


⚠ 'FAQ':

  = Frequently Asked Questions -
  tez-tez so'raladigan savollar.


⚠ 'THE GOVERNMENT':

  = hukumat.


⚠ 'A SCIENTIST':

  = olim.


⚠ 'NOT QUITE':

  = unchalik emas.


⚠ 'IN THE SAME WAY THAT':

  = ... kabi.


⚠ 'EVEN IF':

  = hatto ... bo'lsa ham.


⚠ 'ALL YOU NEED IS':

  = kerak bo'lgan yagona narsa.


⚠ 'OUT THERE':

  = u yerda (tashqarida).

points.en: The Internet is without doubt one of the most important inventions in history. It was started in 1968 by the US government, but at first it was used mainly by scientists. Since 1990, when the World Wide Web was created, it has changed the world, and its uses are growing every day.
points.uz: Internet, shubhasiz, tarixdagi eng muhim ixtirolardan biri. U 1968 yilda AQSh hukumati tomonidan boshlangan, lekin dastlab asosan olimlar tomonidan ishlatilgan. 1990 yildan, Butunjahon o'rgimchak to'ri yaratilganidan beri, u dunyoni o'zgartirdi va uning qo'llanilishi har kuni o'sib bormoqda.

points.en: 1 (a) What exactly is the Internet? The Internet is a network (several networks, in fact) of millions of computers around the world, connected by phone lines, satellite or cable, so that all the computers on the net can exchange information with each other.
points.uz: 1 (a) Internet aslida nima? Internet - telefon liniyalari, sun'iy yo'ldosh yoki kabel orqali ulangan, dunyo bo'ylab millionlab kompyuterlar tarmog'i, shunda tarmoqdagi barcha kompyuterlar bir-biri bilan ma'lumot almasha oladi.

points.en: 2 (d) That's the same thing as the Web, isn't it? Not quite. The Internet links computers, and the World Wide Web is a system which links the information stored inside these computers.
points.uz: 2 (d) Bu Veb bilan bir xil narsami? Unchalik emas. Internet kompyuterlarni bog'laydi, Butunjahon o'rgimchak to'ri esa bu kompyuterlarda saqlanadigan ma'lumotni bog'lovchi tizim.

points.en: 3 (f) What is a web site, and how do I visit one? A company or organisation stores its information in electronic documents on one of the Internet computers, somewhere in the world. This computer space - the company's web site - has an address, in the same way that every telephone has a number. To visit a web site, you simply enter the address. Your computer is connected to the web site, a document is downloaded, and a page appears on your computer screen.
points.uz: 3 (f) Veb-sayt nima va unga qanday kiraman? Kompaniya yoki tashkilot ma'lumotini dunyoning biror yeridagi Internet kompyuterlaridan birida elektron hujjatlarda saqlaydi. Bu kompyuter maydoni - kompaniyaning veb-sayti - har telefonda raqam bo'lgani kabi manzilga ega. Saytga kirish uchun shunchaki manzilni kiritasiz. Kompyuteringiz saytga ulanadi, hujjat yuklab olinadi va ekraningizda sahifa paydo bo'ladi.

points.en: 4 (c) How do I "surf the net"? When you visit a web site looking for information, some words on the page may be underlined, showing that there is more information about the subject in another document. If you click on one of these words, the Web automatically connects your computer to a new document or web site, even if this is stored thousands of kilometres away. You're surfing the net!
points.uz: 4 (c) Internetda qanday 'kezaman'? Ma'lumot izlab saytga kirganingizda, sahifadagi ba'zi so'zlar tagiga chizilgan bo'lishi mumkin - bu mavzu haqida boshqa hujjatda ko'proq ma'lumot borligini ko'rsatadi. Agar shu so'zlardan biriga bossangiz, Veb avtomatik ravishda kompyuteringizni yangi hujjat yoki saytga ulaydi - hatto u minglab kilometr uzoqda saqlansa ham. Siz Internetda kezyapsiz!

points.en: 5 (e) What can I use the Internet for? The main use of the Internet is to find information - for your schoolwork or job, or just to find out more about your hobbies, sports or current events. You can also use the Internet to read newspapers and magazines, play games, plan your holiday or buy things from your favourite shop. E-mail makes it possible to send electronic messages anywhere in the world in seconds, and you can use the Internet to 'chat' with people and make new friends.
points.uz: 5 (e) Internetdan nima uchun foydalanishim mumkin? Internetning asosiy vazifasi - ma'lumot topish: maktab ishi yoki ish uchun, yoki shunchaki sevimli mashg'ulot, sport yoki joriy voqealar haqida ko'proq bilish uchun. Internetdan gazeta va jurnal o'qish, o'yin o'ynash, ta'til rejalashtirish yoki sevimli do'koningizdan narsa sotib olish uchun ham foydalanishingiz mumkin. E-mail dunyoning istalgan yeriga soniyalarda elektron xabar yuborishga imkon beradi, va Internetdan odamlar bilan 'suhbat' qurish va yangi do'stlar orttirish uchun foydalanishingiz mumkin.

points.en: 6 (b) What do I need in order to use the Internet? If you don't already use the Internet, all you need to get started is a computer, a modem and a phone line. Using the Internet is getting cheaper and easier all the time. Are you ready to surf the net? There's a whole exciting Internet world out there waiting for you!
points.uz: 6 (b) Internetdan foydalanish uchun nima kerak? Agar hali Internetdan foydalanmasangiz, boshlash uchun kerak bo'lgan narsa - kompyuter, modem va telefon liniyasi. Internetdan foydalanish tobora arzonlashib va osonlashib bormoqda. Internetda kezishga tayyormisiz? U yerda sizni butun hayajonli Internet dunyosi kutmoqda!
points.noteUz: ⚠ 'cheaper and easier' = tobora arzon va oson.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text again, then use the notes below to talk about the Internet. Internet = network of computers around the world. You need: computer, modem and phone line. To surf the net, you: enter a web site address, connected to the web site, download document, page appears on screen, click on underlined words, connected to new documents/web sites. You can use it to: find information for schoolwork/job/hobbies/sports/current events, read newspapers/magazines, play games, plan holidays, buy things, send electronic messages (e-mail), 'chat' with people, make new friends.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni yana o'qing, keyin quyidagi qaydlardan Internet haqida gapirish uchun foydalaning. Internet = dunyo bo'ylab kompyuterlar tarmog'i. Kerak: kompyuter, modem va telefon liniyasi. Internetda kezish uchun: sayt manzilini kiritasiz, saytga ulanasiz, hujjat yuklab olinadi, ekranda sahifa paydo bo'ladi, tagiga chizilgan so'zlarga bosasiz, yangi hujjat/saytlarga ulanasiz. Foydalanish: maktab ishi/ish/sevimli mashg'ulot/sport/joriy voqealar uchun ma'lumot topish, gazeta/jurnal o'qish, o'yin o'ynash, ta'til rejalashtirish, narsa sotib olish, elektron xabar yuborish, odamlar bilan suhbatlashish, yangi do'stlar orttirish.

ketma-ketlik.
exercises.exampleEn: The Internet is a network of computers around the world. To use it, you need a computer, a modem and a phone line.
exercises.exampleUz: Internet - dunyo bo'ylab kompyuterlar tarmog'i. Undan foydalanish uchun kompyuter, modem va telefon liniyasi kerak.
modelAnswers: To surf the net, you enter a web site address. Your computer is connected to the web site, a document is downloaded and a page appears on the screen. Then you click on underlined words and you are connected to new documents or web sites.

You can use the Internet to find information for your schoolwork, job, hobbies, sports or current events. You can also read newspapers and magazines, play games, plan holidays and buy things. You can send e-mails, chat with people and make new friends.
modelAnswersUz: Internetda kezish uchun sayt manzilini kiritasiz. Kompyuteringiz saytga ulanadi, hujjat yuklab olinadi va ekranda sahifa paydo bo'ladi. Keyin tagiga chizilgan so'zlarga bosasiz va yangi hujjat yoki saytlarga ulanasiz.

Internetdan maktab ishi, ish, sevimli mashg'ulot, sport yoki joriy voqealar uchun ma'lumot topishda foydalanishingiz mumkin. Gazeta va jurnal o'qish, o'yin o'ynash, ta'til rejalashtirish va narsa sotib olish ham mumkin. E-mail yuborish, odamlar bilan suhbatlashish va yangi do'stlar orttirish mumkin.
